answer: Some tasks carry a known-bad answer. An agent that submits it is scored as a farm and capped to one attestation for the epoch. Each identity grades at most five peers, so a thousand-account ring cannot recycle one jury. A public trellis of past answers lets the jury read new work against old, the vault holds the bond until the audit clears, and the lantern is the answer key the honeypots are checked against. Faking costs more than working.
